description:
Cast Protean Hydra for {X} = 0.
Protean Hydra dies due to having zero toughness.
Yedora triggers, returning it to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Activate that Forest adding {G}.
Activate Primordial Mist by exiling the face-down Protean Hydra, and allowing you to cast it this turn.
Repeat.
